cases.name: Kassedi Storm Clark
cases.about: "She loved with her whole heart," her friend Crystal Provencher said. "[She has] pulled over on the side of the road to take the jacket off her back and the few dollars out of her pocket to give to a homeless man sitting on the side of the road with a sign."
